Class Camera

java.lang.Object
renderer.Camera
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class Camera extends Object implements Cloneable
Camera class represents a physical camera in 3D space. This class defines the viewpoint, orientation, and view plane configurations. It is responsible for constructing rays through specific pixels.
